from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as written in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other provided papers found in this paper's bibliography or references section")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
